quoteForm.title: Submit your quote request
quoteForm.intro: Tell us what you're interested in and how to reach you. Our team will follow up directly with pricing and availability — no payment is collected here.

signIn.title: Verify your phone number
signIn.intro: We use your number only to confirm your quote request — this doesn't create an account. We text you a one-time code, and this browser then stays verified for 30 days.
signIn.cookieNote: A small cookie in this browser remembers that your number is verified.
